title: fix(app-shell): PageView refreshes a page action’s data in place on the invalidation bus instead of remounting the page (objectui#10519)
body:
Fixes #10519
Clause-②: no

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM, session `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN` (`mode:subagent`, so that id is also this run's: `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`), from claim comment 5855640194 on objectui#10519, executing the unblock 5854561985 and seat decision B 5830213285. Branch `claude/issue-10519-pageview-refresh-in-place`, cut from `origin/main` `b5b6f37531` (BASE); round-1 head `4620ba39d2`. Round 2 (after the contract review 5856227410, FAIL; the ruling 5856239953, readers first; the `Blocked-by` amendment 5857953021) merged `origin/main` `195052fff6` as `25c9aa6d3a` and re-ran the census there. It stopped at the census: see **H1, round 2**. Round 3 (after the seat ruling 5860118207, readers first, and objectui#10853 landing through PR objectui#10873 as `de1b879a6`) merged `origin/main` `1c5ee334a2` as `c5b63fb514`, re-ran the census there with every row green (**H1, round 3**), and carried review items 2 to 4 and the ratchet titles. Head `42226f9ed1`.

## What changed

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx`: the `refreshKey` counter is gone, together with the `key` on both render branches (`InterfaceListPage`, ADR-0047 interface mode, and `SchemaRenderer`, the page). The console action runtime's `onRefresh` now points at a module-level `declarePageDataChanged`, which is `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })` from `@object-ui/react`: a page binds no object and the runtime's refresh carries none, so the bus's documented unknown-scope value is the page's scope. The node `context` handed to `SchemaRenderer` is `{ params }` alone. `useState` is no longer imported. No prop, export or schema key moves.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.context-9673.test.tsx`: the expected node context is `{ params }` (it was `params` plus `refreshKey: 0`); the header sentence says why.
- `packages/app-shell/src/no-refresh-key-remount.ratchet.test.ts`: the header no longer calls `PageView.onRefresh` a user "Refresh this page" affordance. By a source reading of `useConsoleActionRuntime`, `onRefresh` is fed only by the runtime's post-action refresh (`api`, flow and server-action success, undo, screen-flow completion), and `PageView` has no refresh control. `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView` joins `IN_SCOPE`. Every other assertion is kept. Its two `it` titles now name the `PageView` page host beside the record-detail surfaces (round 3, titles only).
- New pin `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.refreshInPlace-10519.test.tsx` (below).
- `.changeset/10519-pageview-refresh-in-place.md`: `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`. Round 3: the refresh follows a page-level action "that asks for a refresh"; `PageView`, not the runtime, declares the change; the block list is exactly the set the round-3 census measured green.
- `.changeset/9673-pageview-drop-context-spread.md` (pending, not in the app-shell `CHANGELOG`): "The node's `context` is now exactly `{ params, refreshKey }`, built from the route and the refresh counter, and the `as any` cast at that spot is gone." becomes "The node's `context` is now built from the route alone, and the `as any` cast at that spot is gone." A plain replacement, not a dated note: the edit can only reach a release together with this PR's code (a release that consumed the entry first would ship the old sentence, true for that release, and turn this edit into a modify/delete conflict), so the replacement is the entry's one release-scoped reading. Frontmatter byte-identical (md5 of lines 1 to 3 `4e8ce55021fe3b14329c8b4cb3f9f354` before and after); `check-changeset-overwrite` reads `@object-ui/app-shell: patch` at base and now.

## H1 — premise: the census rows re-read in place on `origin/main`

Runtime census on BASE `b5b6f37531`, through a scratch probe (deleted, never committed): the real `SchemaRenderer`, each plugin's real registration, one counting fake data source per row; reads on mount, then `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })`, then reads again. A bare `useDataInvalidation` reader beside each block is the positive control, and its nonce moved 0 → 1 in every row. The probe lived under `app-shell` because the root vitest alias map resolves every `@object-ui/plugin-*` specifier to source there; committed, it would trip `check:phantom-deps` (the objectui#10572 PR made the same call).

| block | reads on mount → after the bus event | re-reads in place |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `object-grid` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-chart` (aggregate) | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `detail-view` (findOne) | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `list-view` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-kanban` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-metric` (aggregate) | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form`, default arm (findOne) | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: drawer` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: modal` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: split` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: tabbed` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: wizard` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-calendar` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-gallery` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-timeline` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-gantt` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `element:number` (aggregate) | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `element:repeater` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-map` | not probed here: its committed pin `ObjectMap.invalidationRefetch-10623` mocks `react-map-gl/maplibre`, which does not resolve from app-shell; that pin ran green on BASE in the same lock run (3 cases) | yes |
| `list` (bare key) | n/a | not a data block: `@object-ui/components` owns the bare key as the display list, and plugin-list registers `ListViewRenderer` as `view:list` with `skipFallback: true` so that it never takes that key; `view:list` is the `list-view` row's renderer. |

The studio palette's data category (`BLOCK_TYPE_META`) is `grid`, `object-grid`, `object-form`, `object-metric`, `object-kanban`; every object-bound entry is in the table. Every block in this table, the six `object-form` arms included, re-reads exactly once after the bus event on BASE. What this PR claims covers the census rows only, not every block a stored page can hold: this table; the rows of the round-2 table (`object-tree`, `object-pivot`, `object-data-table`, `report` / `spec-report` over a dataset, `record:line_items` with an authored parent, a `dashboard` dataset table widget), whose readers landed with objectui#10778 and objectui#10814; and the rows round 3 adds, `object-master-detail-form`'s edit-mode detail lines and `element:record_picker`'s options, whose readers landed with objectui#10853. On the merged head `c5b63fb514` every one of them re-reads once in place with no remount (**H1, round 3**).

## H1, round 2 — census on the merged head `25c9aa6d3a`

The round-1 probe, re-run unchanged on its 18 rows, plus the rows the ruling names and one for the `dashboard` block, whose dataset widgets read on a page since objectui#10815. Scratch probes again, never committed, archived in the seat scratchpad (`issue-10519/census-10519-r2.probe.test.tsx.archived`, md5 `ba70dc05bf7a266d6a7535c9c7990b2e`; `issue-10519/census-10519-r2-md.probe.test.tsx.archived`, md5 `2d830df32bf6975b2be2edc5cb2050ef`). New this round, a remount witness: the row's own registry entry (`ComponentRegistry.get`, which `SchemaRenderer` resolves the node through) is wrapped in a counter whose dependency-free mount effect runs once per instance and whose cleanup runs once per unmount. Witness control: `object-metric` under a host re-keyed on the bus nonce, the shape of the removed `key={refreshKey}`, reads `1 → 2` like an in-place re-read, and the witness reads mounts `1 → 2`, unmounts `+1`. So the read count alone cannot tell the two apart, and the witness can. Run under the verify lock, `Tests 29 passed (29)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0` (26 probe cases, the three `ObjectMap.invalidationRefetch-10623` cases).

| block | reads on mount → after the bus event | mounts at the event → after · unmounts | re-reads in place, no remount |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| the 18 round-1 rows (`object-grid`, `object-chart`, `detail-view`, `list-view`, `object-kanban`, `object-metric`, `object-form` default / drawer / modal / split / tabbed / wizard, `object-calendar`, `object-gallery`, `object-timeline`, `object-gantt`, `element:number`, `element:repeater`) | 1 → 2 each | 1 → 1 · +0 each | yes |
| `object-tree` | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| `object-pivot` | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| `object-data-table` | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| `report` over a dataset (`queryDataset`) | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| `spec-report` over a dataset (`queryDataset`) | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| `record:line_items` with an authored `parentId` | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| `dashboard`, a dataset table widget (`queryDataset`) | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| `object-map` | its committed pin `ObjectMap.invalidationRefetch-10623`, same run: one re-read after `'*'`, the map node unchanged (3 cases) | n/a | yes |
| witness control: `object-metric` under a host re-keyed on the nonce | 1 → 2 | 1 → 2 · +1 | by remount only |

**Two blocks a stored page can hold do not re-read. This is the stop condition 5854561985, and round 2 stopped here.**

| block, as a stored page holds it | reads on mount → after the bus event | mounts · unmounts | re-reads in place |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `object-master-detail-form`, `mode: 'edit'`, authored `recordId`: the header (`findOne` of the parent) | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| the same block: its detail lines (`find` of the child object) | 2 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | **no** |
| the same block under a host re-keyed on the nonce: its detail lines | 2 → 4 | 1 → 2 | by remount only |
| `element:record_picker`: its options (`find` of its object) | 1 → 1 | 1 → 1 · +0 | **no** |

- **A stored page can hold both.** Both are `ComponentPropsMap` keys in `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0, the installed version. `PageSchema.safeParse` accepts a page holding `object-master-detail-form` with `mode: 'edit'`, `recordId` and `details`, and `ComponentPropsMap['object-master-detail-form']` parses those properties. objectui registers both: `object-master-detail-form` in `plugin-form`, which the console's `register-plugins.ts` imports eagerly, and `record_picker` in `components`. Both read through the page's adapter (`SchemaRendererContext`, `useAdapter()`).
- **Source reading (context, not the measurement).** `MasterDetailForm`'s edit-mode children effect keys on `isEdit`, `dataSource`, `schema.recordId` and `resolvedEntries`. The picker's option effect keys on `adapter`, `object`, `filterKey`, `sortKey` and `limit`. Neither names a bus nonce, so after a page action nothing re-runs them, and before this PR the remount did.
- **Recorded, not gating.** `object-form` with `subforms` routes to the same `MasterDetailForm` and measured the same (lines 2 → 2). But `ComponentPropsMap['object-form']` refuses `subforms` by name (`unrecognized_keys`), so a spec-valid page does not hold that route.
- **Resolved in round 3.** objectui#10853 (PR objectui#10873, `de1b879a6`) gave both blocks a bus reader, and round 3 measures them green below. Review items 2 to 4 and the ratchet `it` titles are on the branch.

Real `SchemaRenderer`, real registrations, one counting fake data source per row, one `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })`, the same remount witness and its control. Scratch probe, never committed, archived in the seat scratchpad as `issue-10519/census-10519-r3.probe.test.tsx.archived` (md5 `b1d116c257b12b3e35928dc35ddb113b`), rows in `issue-10519/census-rows-r3-head.txt`. Run under the verify lock with `ObjectMap.invalidationRefetch-10623`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 33 passed (33)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0` (30 probe cases, 3 map cases). The detail lines read twice on mount, as objectui#10853 measured at its BASE (the load effect runs again once the resolved details are set); the bus event adds exactly one read.

**Unsaved lines are held, then re-read once after a revert or a save** (objectui#10853's rule, measured through the same block, one bus event each):

| case | line reads at the event → while dirty → after | mounts · unmounts | lines on screen while held |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| type into the first line, `'*'`, then type the stored value back (revert) | 2 → 2 → 3 | 1 → 1 · +0 | `["first edited"]` |
| type into the first line, `'*'`, then the form's save (`batchTransaction` once) | 2 → 2 → 3 | 1 → 1 · +0 | n/a |

No block a stored page can hold, among the census rows, still refreshes only through the remount. The stop condition 5854561985 does not hold this round.

## H2 — the remount, reproduced on BASE

The new pin run against BASE `PageView.tsx` (byte-identical to BASE by blob hash `9de300582c`) with the head pins kept, before any source edit: `Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`.

- SchemaRenderer branch, red on (a): `The page action REMOUNTED the page: the SchemaRenderer consumer mounted a second time` — the `object-gantt` stand-in's instance counter read 2 after one `api` action.
- interface branch, red on (a): `The page action REMOUNTED the interface page` — the `interface-list-page` node after the action was not the node before it.
- lit control green: a change declared on the bus directly reached the metric and the stand-in once each, with no action run.

## Pins and ablations

`PageView.refreshInPlace-10519.test.tsx` renders `PageView` for real under `MemoryRouter`, `AdapterCtx` and `SchemaRendererProvider`, with the real console action runtime, the real `page`, `page:accordion` and `action:button` renderers, the real `object-metric` (plugin-dashboard) and `object-form` (plugin-form) blocks, and, on the interface branch, the real `InterfaceListPage` over plugin-list's `ListView`. The stand-in registered as `object-gantt` follows the `ObjectView.refreshInPlace-10035` precedent: it reads the real bus hook, counts its own queries, and carries an instance id and a scroll box. The page action is a real `api` action (`target: /api/v1/environments`) through the runtime's `apiHandler`, an authenticated raw-HTTP call that fires no dataSource `onMutation`.

After one page action:

- (a) the same tree: the stand-in mounted exactly once (instance id unchanged), its scroll box is the same node with `scrollTop` still 120, the metric node is the same, the form's `name` input is the same node and still reads the half-typed `User typed`, and the collapsed accordion panel still has `aria-expanded="false"`; on the interface branch the `interface-list-page` node and `ListView`'s own `refresh-button` node are unchanged.
- (b) each bus reader re-read exactly once: the metric's `aggregate` delta is 1, the stand-in's query delta is 1, and `ListView`'s list query delta (its `$top: 0` count probe excluded) is 1.
- lit control: `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })` with no action reaches the metric and the stand-in once each.

Red on base, green on head, and two ablation legs, all on committed state with every restore spelled `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH` and proven by blob hash, `git diff HEAD` empty and `git status` clean:

| leg | mutation (on-disk proof) | result over the pin, the ratchet and context-9673 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1, reverse run | `PageView.tsx` checked out at BASE (blob `9de300582c` == BASE blob; `key={refreshKey}` sites 2, `notifyDataChanged` sites 0), head pins kept | `Tests 5 failed | 2 passed (7)`: ratchet red (`expected [ …(2) ] to deeply equal []`, the two key sites), context-9673 red on both cases (`+ "refreshKey": 0`), the pin red on (a) on both branches; the ratchet's scan-path guard and the pin's lit control green. Restore: blob `8e96f4adbf` == HEAD blob, diff empty, status clean |
| A2, the host declares nothing | through `ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' });` hit 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob `8e96f4adbf` → `83a296ea0a` | `Tests 2 failed | 5 passed (7)`: the pin red on (b) on both branches (`The metric did not re-read after the action`, `The list did not re-query after the action`); (a), the lit control, the ratchet and context-9673 green. Restore by the tool: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty |

Each leg fails on the half the defect predicts and nowhere else, so each pin fails for the reason it names. No `dist/` preflight applies: every test here imports `PageView` from `src`, and the root vitest alias map resolves every `@object-ui/*` specifier to source.

## Acceptance notes

- The bare `list` key is the display list by design (plugin-list `src/index.tsx`); no finding.
- Not filed, nit: `useConsoleActionRuntime`'s `onRefresh` doc comment still describes the refresh as "bump a refresh key to re-fetch embedded data"; `ObjectView` still bumps one (plus the bus, objectui#10035), so the sentence is stale only for this host.
